The Pattern of Heaven

The Same Warning — Amplified

The Loud Cry of Revelation 18 is not a new message. It is the same separation call of 1843–1844, now swelled to a final thunder. Heaven used the same pattern before: the Midnight Cry joined the Second Angel. At the end, the Loud Cry joins the Third Angel.

"Come out of her, my people." — Rev. 18:4

The Danger of Return

Do Not Go Back

The Third Angel’s Message is a warning not to backslide into the very errors the pioneers cast off during the Second Angel’s Cry in 1843–1844. The Loud Cry exposes the corruptions that have entered the churches since October 22, 1844.

“The third angel’s message was, and still is, a WARNING to the saints to ‘hold fast,’ and not go back, and ‘receive’ THE MARKS which the virgin band got rid of, during the second angel’s cry.”

— James White, A Word to the Little Flock, p. 11

What Was Cast Off in 1843–1844

The early Advent movement separated from errors the Protestant Reformation had failed to fully leave behind. James White named them plainly:

“The greatest fault we can find in the Reformation is, the Reformers stopped reforming. Had they gone on, and onward, till they had left the last vestige of Papacy behind — such as natural immortality, sprinkling, the trinity, and Sunday-keeping — the church would now be free from her unscriptural errors.”

— James White, Review & Herald, February 7, 1856, Vol. 7, No. 19, p. 148
Errors to Never Return To

The Marks Cast Off in 1844

  • Sunday-keeping (man’s tradition replacing God’s 7th-day Sabbath)
  • Natural immortality of the soul (contrary to Scripture)
  • Sprinkling (replacing immersion baptism)
  • The Trinitarian formula (vestiges of Papal doctrinal residue)
  • Church and State union (the very system the pioneers fled)
  • Corporate political incorporation under civil government
Heaven’s command: Do not go back.

The Pattern of Return

Backsliding is not advancement. It is not “maturity.” It is not “institutional strength.” It is the slow, polished, respectable return to what God once called a people to leave. What Heaven exposed, many later excused. What the protest cast off, later generations took back up.

“They had a bright light set up behind them at the first end of the path, which an angel told me was the Midnight Cry… Others rashly denied the light behind them… The light behind them went out, leaving their feet in perfect darkness.”

— Ellen G. White, Spiritual Gifts, Vol. 2, p. 30.2
Documentary Record

April 15, 1904 — The Day It Became Official

What began as Laodicean drift in 1845 was crowned on April 15, 1904, in Washington, District of Columbia: the formation of a new corporate church-state entity bearing the historic Adventist name but departing from the pioneer foundations.

“Since the time of the Minneapolis meeting [1888], I have seen the state of the Laodicean church as never before… Like the Jews, many have closed their eyes lest they should see.”

— Ellen G. White, Review and Herald, August 26, 1890

The Warning Was Written Before the Event

“The enemy of souls has sought to bring in the supposition that a great reformation was to take place among Seventh-day Adventists, and that this reformation would consist in giving up the doctrines which stand as the pillars of our faith, and engaging in a process of reorganization… A new organization would be established… Books of a new order would be written… The Sabbath of course, would be lightly regarded… Nothing would be allowed to stand in the way of the new movement.”

— Ellen G. White, Selected Messages, Book 1, p. 204 (1SM 204)

Warning: The White Estate Trustees and General Conference leaders have engaged in extensive editing, re-compiling, and adding misleading headers to Ellen White’s writings—especially in books like Evangelism—to make it appear that she supported doctrines and practices she actually warned against. They have taken her words out of context to validate their rejection of truth sent from heaven and to cover their errors and sins. In amazement, people learn that Babylon is the church because of her rejection of the truth sent to her from heaven and her adoption of Rome’s false doctrines, such as the Trinity.

In 1980, the General Conference formally restored the Trinity doctrine as Fundamental Belief #2, a teaching the original pioneers had thrown out as a papal error. Neal C. Wilson, then president of the General Conference, stated under oath:

"There is another universal and truly catholic organization, the Seventh-day Adventist Church..." (EEOC vs. Pacific Press Publishing Association and GC, Civil Case #74-2025 CBR, 1974-1975, transcript, p. 4)

He also testified:

"Although it is true that there was a period in the life of the Seventh-day Adventist Church when the denomination took a distinctly anti-Roman Catholic viewpoint, and the term 'hierarchy' was used in a pejorative sense to refer to the papal form of church governance, that attitude on the church's part was nothing more than a manifestation of widespread anti-popery among conservative Protestant denominations in the early part of this century and the latter part of the last, and which has now been consigned to the historical trash heap so far as the Seventh-day Adventist Church is concerned." (EEOC vs. Pacific Press Publishing Association and GC, transcript, p. 4)

The White Estate, Inc.—a church-and-state corporation—has severely edited and changed Ellen White’s books to promote the Trinity and other doctrines the pioneers rejected. Many members have never heard the original warnings. When people ask their pastors about these things, the false shepherds often urge them to remain in their pews and ignore the evidence, working to keep the truth hidden.

To read the original, unedited pioneer books, articles, sermons, tracts, and charts, visit the Pioneer Gateway Library.

501(c)(3) = Church and State Married

A 501(c)(3) designation is issued by the federal government. It places a religious organization under the authority, rules, and oversight of civil power — the very definition of the union of church and state that the Revelation 13 beast represents.

  • ›Church submits to state rules for tax exemption
  • ›Civil government grants and can revoke the status
  • ›Church becomes a registered, regulated business entity
  • ›Controls thousands of subsidiary businesses under its parent structure

Like Korah, Dathan, and Abiram

This corporate rebellion bears a striking resemblance to Korah, Dathan, and Abiram in Numbers 16 — men who challenged Heaven’s order while pretending to honor it. In many respects, Elder James White stood to the Advent movement as Moses stood to Israel: a leading laborer, a protester, a standard-bearer. Yet after the pioneer era, rebellious leadership steered many into Laodicean softness, policy, machinery, and compromise.

“As is the mother, so is her daughter.”

— Ezekiel 16:44 (KJV)

“The desolation of Jerusalem [in 70 AD] stands as a solemn warning before the eyes of modern Israel [Adventists].”

— Ellen G. White

The Same Warning — The Same Separation — The Same Preparation

Heaven’s message has not changed. The Loud Cry is not a polite suggestion to remain where truth has been buried under compromise. It is heaven’s final alarm to honest souls still inside corrupt and backslidden systems.

The Second Angel said: Babylon is fallen.
The Midnight Cry said: Go ye out to meet Him.
The Loud Cry says: Come out of her, My people.

Same warning. Same separation. Same preparation for the Bridegroom.
Come out. Stay out. Do not go back.

Remember Lot’s Wife. Remember the Sabbath.

Christ said, “Remember Lot’s wife.” The fourth commandment says, “Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.” One warning says: do not look back. The other says: do not forget what God made holy. The final crisis gathers around both memory and loyalty. Heaven calls a people to remember, to separate, to obey, and to be ready.
